marketInfo.assetDescription:
NGI+ is a tokenized interest in a private infrastructure equity fund linked to Partners Group Next Generation Infrastructure.

  • Manager: Partners Group, a Swiss-listed private-markets manager (~USD 185B AUM).
  • Value: Tracks the fund's monthly NAV per share, net of fees. Grows through NAV appreciation, not on-chain distributions.
  • Points: NGI+ positions on Pendle earn Reale Points.
  • Underlying APY: Annualised change in NGI+ NAV (USDC per NGI+) over the trailing 90 days. The fund updates NAV about monthly, so the figure moves in steps. Historical, not a forecast. Can be negative if NAV falls.
  • YT yield: Paid only when NAV rises above its previous high (high-water mark). After a NAV drop, realised YT yield can be lower than the displayed APY until NAV recovers.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• Backed by a private markets fund. NAV updates monthly and can rise or fall.
  • Fund redemptions have periodic limits and can be restricted or suspended.

(From Underlying Protocol)
marketInfo.importantQuirks:
Two ways to trade NGI+:

  • Instant Router (recommended): Settles on-chain immediately. No KYC, no minimum. Routed to AMM pools or RFQ market makers, so size depends on on-chain liquidity.
  • Primary Market: KYC required. Min 100,000 USDC or equivalent. Monthly dealing cycle: - Subscribe by T-10, tokens delivered by T+23
  • Redeem by T-45, proceeds paid by T+26

Best for tickets larger than on-chain liquidity.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
Axis's USDx is a dollar-denominated, over-collateralized synthetic dollar that finances positions and settles trades within the Axis Protocol. Backing consists of digital and tokenized assets, plus traditional assets and their corresponding futures/hedge positions that keep the book market-neutral.

USDx does not accrue yield natively — yield is earned by staking USDx into sUSDx. Backing and transparency reports are available here.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• Peg risk: USDx is not a hard-pegged stablecoin and can trade above or below $1 based on live trading conditions. Exits may be delayed, expensive, or unavailable during market stress.

  • Counterparty & custody risk: Backing assets are held across multiple trading venues and off-chain custodians; a venue halt, default, or freeze can impact recovery.

  • Market & execution risk: Hedges may be imperfect and expected spreads can compress or reverse.

(From Underlying Protocol)

marketInfo.assetDescription: The Royco Senior Tranche for apyUSD represents a prioritized, low-risk market where conservative users provide liquidity in exchange for stable returns and principal protection. It provides a reliable yield by maintaining a "first-claim" right on apyUSD dividends, while offloading the risk of principal loss to the Junior Tranche, which acts as a buffer up to the coverage % shown here.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
The Senior Tranche exchange rate is designed to be nearly always increasing because junior capital absorbs losses first, providing a protective buffer. However, the exchange rate can decrease under the following circumstances:

  • Junior Coverage Exhaustion: When losses in the underlying investment exceed the total junior capital available to absorb them, the remaining losses flow through to senior holders.

Potential risks and events which may lead to the yield going negative or depositors losing money: While mAPOLLO is intended to be an ‚Äúup-only‚Äù token in terms of exchange rate (similar to other Midas-issued tokens such as mEDGE and mMEV), several risks could still affect performance:

  • Underlying Strategy Risk: The reference portfolio comprises market-neutral, stablecoin-focused DeFi strategies. Unexpected market events, protocol failures, liquidity shortfalls, or mispricing could lead to reduced returns or losses in the underlying strategies.
  • Protocol Risk: Smart contract vulnerabilities, oracle failures, or integration issues with DeFi protocols used in the reference strategies could negatively affect performance.
  • Counterparty Risk: The appointed risk manager, Apollo Crypto, and any underlying protocol counterparties could fail to deliver expected execution or risk controls.
  • Regulatory/Legal Risk: Changes in applicable laws or enforcement actions could restrict certain strategies or limit product operations.
  • Operational Risk: Failures in execution, custody, or settlement infrastructure could cause delays or losses.

Although the token's exchange rate is designed to move upward as yield accrues in the reference portfolio, adverse events in any of the above categories could reduce or eliminate returns.

$alUSD = tokenized shares of the Autonomous Liquidity USD vault, a conservative, code-based $USDC yield strategy collaboratively built using the Almanak AI Swarm.

The vault continuously scans DeFi markets to allocate USDC across an approved set of protocols: Fluid, Euler v2, Aave v3, Compound v3, Morpho Blue vaults, and Yearn v3. It rebalances only when yield gains justify costs, while auto-compounding and advanced routing maximize efficiency across market conditions.

Each day, 333,333 Almanak Points are distributed to TVL providers, with every point corresponding to roughly 1 Almanak token.

Almanak Points are distributed once every 24 hours and are not subject to locks or penalties. Points already farmed remain with you even if you exit YT-alUSD positions.

We recommend procuring alUSD from the vault directly to avoid slippage and high price impact.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
Junior USDe (jrUSDe) is a yield-bearing investment product, representing the junior risk tranche in Strata’s structure. It provides leveraged upside to sUSDe APY while simultaneously functioning as a liquid insurance pool for srUSDe. By absorbing excess risk and volatility associated with sUSDe APY, jrUSDe earns a risk premium from the senior tranche, delivering potentially higher yields for risk-tolerant investors.

jrUSDe receives the residual yield after the senior tranche is paid and absorbs any shortfall when sUSDe APY falls below the guaranteed minimum yield for srUSDe tied to the benchmark rate (Supply-weighted average of USDC/USDT lending rates on Aave Core). As a result, jrUSDe outperforms sUSDe APY in high-yield environments but may underperform when sUSDe APY drops below the benchmark rate.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
jrUSDe may generate negative yield when the sUSDe APY falls below the benchmark rate, resulting in a portion of the jrUSDe reserves being allocated to srUSDe to guarantee the srUSDe floor APY.

(From Underlying Protocol)
marketInfo.importantQuirks: • Instant withdrawal to sUSDe is subjected to 0.1% redemption fee.
